Expand counting-process data to person-days

Source: R/prepare.R
expand_person_days.Rd

Turns each (tstart, tstop] interval into one row per day, with event = 1 only on the day of reporting. Optionally attaches the daily incidence rate for the person's age group and vaccination status.

Usage

expand_person_days(cp, incidence = NULL)

Arguments

cp

Output of counting_process().

incidence

Optional output of daily_incidence().

Value

A tibble with one row per person-day: ind_id, age, age_group, sex, day, tstart, tstop (= day), event, vax_status, time_of_vaccination, days_since_vax (NA when unvaccinated) and, if incidence is given, incidence_rate.
